name: J11
mesh_airframe: Shenyang J-11A (FlightGear SU-27SK package by Yanes Bechir / FGUK; Models/Su-27.ac, shared with the package's Su-27SK variant)
note: Owner decision 3 (docs/phase3/decisions.md): the J-11A from yanes19/SU-27SK at 925cb531, GPL-2.0. The FDM is the package's J-11A.xml vendored as assets/fdm_root/aircraft/J11/J11.xml with its LICENSE and a provenance header listing every local edit; the mesh is fetched at import time (source_dir is git-ignored). Decision 6: no control surfaces. j11-package lane (2026-11-09): the conversion also reads the package's PLAAF livery, cockpit interior, seat and pilot, each file pinned by git blob sha1 and sha256 in package_files.

parts.source: Models/J-11A.xml <model> panel-zh.xml <offsets> (0.3, -0.01, 0) m; panel-zh.xml <path>panel.ac</path> at its own origin
panel-zh.xml seat2.ac <offsets> (5.0, 0.01, 0.6) m pitch -5 deg, plus the panel-zh.xml offset (0.3, -0.01, 0) m

panel-zh.xml pilot.xml <offsets> (5.0, 0.01, 0.95) m, plus the panel-zh.xml offset (0.3, -0.01, 0) m; pilot.xml <path>fighter_default.ac</path>; its head and visor animations are not applied (drawn at rest)

parts_source: the store offsets are the FDM's own pylon2-load / pylon3-load <pointmass> locations (metres, structural = FG model frame), which J-11A-set.xml <sim><weight> repeats as the stores' x-m/y-m/z-m offsets; R-27R.ac is the package's own missile model (Models/Stores/Missiles/R-27R), symmetric about its own y and z so one file serves both sides
exclude_source: Su-27.ac at 925cb531 carries 43 objects: hull, canopy, pylons, gear (UC_*), doors, surfaces; lights, effects and hotspots are separate .ac files the model XML attaches, so nothing in this file needs excluding

gear_geometry.source: Su-27.ac names its undercarriage UC_Nose_* (Tyres, Hubs, struts, WGuard, LLights) and UC_Main_Left_* / UC_Main_Right_* (Tyre, Hub, struts); nothing else matches UC_.*. Measured 2026-11-04 from the pinned commit: lowest gear vertex -2.52 m below the model origin (nose and main tyres), the FDM's gear contacts sit at -103.47 in = -2.63 m

dimensions_m.source: [unverified here] published Shenyang J-11 / Sukhoi Su-27 overall length 21.94 m and height 5.92 m, from memory of the type's published characteristics; span from the flown FDM's own <wingspan> (48.23 ft = 14.70 m); the pinned mesh measures 22.08 m nose to tail (0.7 % over the cited length)

nose.source: measured 2026-11-04 from Models/Su-27.ac at commit 925cb531 with assets_pipeline.acmodel (parse_ac, ac_to_model): the frontmost centreline vertex (|y| < 0.3 m) of HULL_Hull_Upper.001 at model-frame (0.006, 0.001, -0.112) m; the .ac origin is taken as the FDM's structural origin because the FDM's main-gear contacts (x 538.04 in = 13.67 m) fall inside the mesh's main tyres (x 13.09..14.18 m) and the FDM's CG station (517.35 in = 13.14 m) is the mesh's mid-fuselage; metres x 39.3701

tail.source: measured 2026-11-04 from Models/Su-27.ac at commit 925cb531 with assets_pipeline.acmodel (parse_ac, ac_to_model): the aftmost centreline vertex (|y| < 0.3 m) of HULL_Hull_Upper.001 at model-frame (22.083, 0.001, 0.007) m, the tail-boom tip; the .ac origin is taken as the FDM's structural origin because the FDM's main-gear contacts (x 538.04 in = 13.67 m) fall inside the mesh's main tyres (x 13.09..14.18 m) and the FDM's CG station (517.35 in = 13.14 m) is the mesh's mid-fuselage; metres x 39.3701

labels.keypoints_note: the FDM's LEFT_WING / RIGHT_WING contacts sit at y = +-24.12 in (0.61 m), wing-root structure points, not tips, so the wingtips are the FDM half-span approximation; the FDM's NOSE gear contact (x 112.09 in = 2.85 m) is 5 m ahead of the mesh's nose gear (x 7.5..8.2 m): the label is where the FDM says the gear is, as the labeller's rule states

components.source: J11.xml <pointmass name="pylon2-load"> 230.21 LBS; the R-27R on the left inboard wing pylon (Models/Stores/Missiles/R-27R/R-27R.ac at the pointmass's own location)
J11.xml <pointmass name="pylon3-load"> 230.21 LBS; the R-27R on the right inboard wing pylon (Models/Stores/Missiles/R-27R/R-27R.ac at the pointmass's own location)

category.regulation: military type: no 14 CFR 23 / 25 category applies; 'military' is the limits table's own category word (core/telemetry/limits.py CATEGORIES)
category.source: stated here; the limits below are the type's published figures [unverified here]

n_z_pos_g.source: [unverified here] published Su-27 / J-11 limit load factor +9 g, from memory of the type's published characteristics

n_z_neg_g.source: [unverified here] -3 g, the figure commonly quoted for the Su-27 family, from memory

speed_limit_kt.source: [unverified here] published Su-27 maximum indicated airspeed 1400 km/h at low level (= 756 kt), from memory, stated as the never-exceed kind the limits table admits (V_NE | V_MO); compared here against JSBSim calibrated airspeed without a position-error correction

m_mo.reason: the type's published maximum Mach, 2.35 at altitude (from memory, [unverified here]), lies outside the (0, 1) range the limits table admits for the subsonic types configured so far (core/telemetry/limits.py parse_limits), so the Mach limit is recorded as unmonitored on this airframe rather than as a number the parser would refuse

alpha_stall_deg.reason: the vendored J11.xml (Aeromatic 0.95 derived, upstream J-11A.xml) states no <alphalimits> element (grep 2026-11-04); the validator's CLmax alpha is a derived quantity, not a stated limit

limits.note: J11.xml is an Aeromatic 0.95 derived model ('Yanes Bechir based on Aeromatic 0.95 output', its own header), ALPHA release: every limit monitored against it is graded on an approximate airframe; the figures above are published numbers from memory, none measured here

loading.source: assets/fdm_root/aircraft/J11/J11.xml <mass_balance> and <propulsion> (vendored from yanes19/SU-27SK J-11A.xml at 925cb531; pylon2/3 weights are recorded edit 3); the maximum weight from the same file's Aeromatic header comment 'max weight: 67142.25 lb'

datum.xml: the J11.xml <location> x in inches, positive aft (the JSBSim structural frame); pointmasses are stated in metres in the same frame; the XML names no reference point beyond VRP (0, 0, 0)

arm_comparison.reason: no J-11 / Su-27 flight-manual arm is transcribed: the envelope check is refused by name (loading.datum_unverified) and the loading is flown at the XML's own arms

package_files_source: j11-package lane, 2026-11-09: every file of github.com/yanes19/SU-27SK at the pinned commit the conversion reads beyond the commit pin; git_blob_sha1 as the GitHub tree API lists it (git/trees/925cb531...?recursive=1) and recomputed from the downloaded bytes, sha256 of the same bytes; verified before every convert (assets_pipeline/package_pins.py, refusal aircraft.package_pin). The full inventory of the package is docs/visual/J11_PACKAGE.md
interior_source: the J-11A model XML includes Models/Interior/panel-zh.xml, which places panel.ac, seat2.ac and the pilot; the three are drawn in the BODY part (the aircraft's class and int_id, no box of their own) and must lie inside the hull's extents (refusal aircraft.interior_outside_hull). Measured 2026-11-09 from the pinned files: panel x 3.86..6.55 m, seat 4.76..5.91 m, pilot 4.81..5.49 m, all |y| <= 0.65 m, z 0.21..1.58 m, inside the hull's (0.01..22.08, +-7.62, -2.52..3.78) m and under the canopy glass top (z 1.72 m). NOT imported: the stick, pedals, throttle block and the 85 animated instrument and console sub-model meshes (Models/Interior/Instruments, LeftPanels, RightPanels), each its own .ac with Nasal/canvas animation; the front panel texture carries the instrument faces

livery.source: Models/J-11A.xml <animation><type>material</type> (property-base sim/model/livery, texture-prop texture): these ten objects take the selected livery's texture; Models/Liveries/PLAAF2Div.xml is the package's one PLAAF scheme (the others are Russian, Ukrainian, Indian and Angolan air forces and Gromov test pilots); every other Su-27.ac object keeps Models/Su-27_Flanker_P01.png, as FlightGear draws it
